hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: To maximize integer value, prioritize placing the largest possible digits in the most significant places.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each position from left to right, assign min(9, remaining_sum).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Validate whether remaining sum is completely exhausted at the end of length n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def largestIntegerWithDigitSum(n: int, s: int) -> str:
    if s < 0 or s > 9 * n:
        return ""
    if s == 0 and n > 1:
        return ""
    digits = []
    rem = s
    for _ in range(n):
        d = min(9, rem)
        digits.append(str(d))
        rem -= d
    return "".join(digits) if rem == 0 else ""
```

complexity.notes: Greedy left-to-right digit allocation runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing numbers of length n has exponential complexity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedily packs digit 9 in high-order positions.
